hikes.name: Skyline Trail Loop
start: Henry M. Jackson Memorial Visitor Center
hikes.blurb: Paradise's great meadow loop: marmots, wildflowers and the Nisqually Glacier, up to a point looking down the Cascades.

hikes.name: Burroughs Mountain
hikes.blurb: Across high tundra to a stony plateau face to face with the Emmons and Winthrop Glaciers.

hikes.name: Mount Fremont Lookout
hikes.blurb: Along Sourdough Ridge to a 1930s lookout perched over Grand Park with Rainier filling the sky.

hikes.name: Tolmie Peak Lookout
hikes.blurb: Past a meadow-ringed lake to a lookout where Rainier's northwest face rises over Eunice Lake.

hikes.name: Spray Falls and Spray Park
hikes.blurb: A broad falls, then climbing into one of the park's biggest wildflower meadows under the mountain.

hikes.name: Naches Peak Loop
hikes.blurb: An easy loop around a peak on the Pacific Crest Trail with tarns, late-summer flowers and huckleberries.

hikes.name: Comet Falls and Van Trump Park
hikes.blurb: Up a steep creek to a 300-foot falls, then into meadows right under the Kautz and Van Trump Glaciers.

hikes.name: Pinnacle Peak Saddle
hikes.blurb: A short steep climb from Reflection Lakes to a gap in the Tatoosh Range facing Rainier's south side.

hikes.name: Snow Lake and Bench Lake
hikes.blurb: Two small lakes in the Tatoosh, the second under Unicorn Peak's cliffs.

hikes.name: Summerland
hikes.blurb: Up Fryingpan Creek on the Wonderland Trail to meadows facing Little Tahoma and the Emmons Glacier.

hikes.name: Glacier Basin
hikes.blurb: Up an old mining road along the Inter Fork to a basin where climbers start for the summit.

hikes.name: Shriner Peak Lookout
hikes.blurb: A hot, steep climb on the park's east edge to a lookout with Rainier straight across the valley.

hikes.name: Camp Muir
start: Henry M. Jackson Memorial Visitor Center
hikes.blurb: Up the Muir Snowfield to the climbers' stone hut at 10,000 feet, half way up the mountain.

hikes.name: Crystal Lakes
hikes.blurb: Up a steep forest trail to two lakes in a high bowl, mountain goats often on the ridge above.

hikes.name: Palisades Lakes
hikes.blurb: Past several small lakes to one under a long wall of columnar rock.

hikes.name: Berkeley Park
hikes.blurb: Down from Sunrise through a stream-cut bowl of wildflowers on the mountain's north side.

hikes.name: Sheep Lake and Sourdough Gap
hikes.blurb: North on the Pacific Crest Trail to a meadow lake and a rocky notch looking back at Rainier.

hikes.name: Dewey Lakes
hikes.blurb: Over Naches Peak's shoulder and down to a pair of lakes in the William O. Douglas Wilderness.

hikes.name: Noble Knob
hikes.blurb: An easy ridge walk outside the park to a flower-covered knob with a wide-open Rainier view.

hikes.name: Myrtle Falls
start: Henry M. Jackson Memorial Visitor Center
hikes.blurb: A short paved walk at Paradise to a falls that frames the mountain.

hikes.name: Rampart Ridge Loop
hikes.blurb: From Longmire up onto a ridge of old forest with a sudden view of the mountain.

hikes.name: Owyhigh Lakes
hikes.blurb: Up through forest to lakes and meadows under the craggy Governors Ridge.

hikes.name: Carbon Glacier
hikes.blurb: Up the Carbon River on the Wonderland Trail to the snout of the lowest glacier in the lower 48.
